postal_system.assignment_rule: The current UPU file updated August 2026 explicitly includes Cameroon in its September 2025 list of countries not requiring postal codes. The UPU 07/2002 CM sheet shows BP 6000 followed by YAOUNDE without a postcode. MINESUP labels 54190 and 1739 as BP/address-postale values. These are P.O.-box identifiers, not national postcodes.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current CM postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Country, region, department, arrondissement, commune, locality, post-office, BP, route, Point, administrative polygon, buffer, hull, Voronoi or raster cell, model output and AGID cell remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: Keep recipient, organization, physical address or BP object, locality and country separate. Do not add a fabricated postcode; a numeric BP remains part of the delivery address object.
postal_system.agid_rule: A source-qualified Yaoundé result may display an independent CM AGID spatial ID, but that ID is not a postcode, BP number, postal assignment, building identity or postal boundary.
postal_system.model_rule: Hugging Face, libpostal and other models may parse or rank source-qualified non-postal context only. They cannot create postal authority, assignments, geometry, rights or building identity.
postal_system.building_rule: Detailed place or building display requires its own rights-cleared civic-address identity and explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: UPU, MINPOSTEL and MINESUP bodies are reference evidence. UPU copyright/database restrictions and Cameroon government all-rights-reserved notices do not grant AGID postal dataset redistribution rights. OSM ODbL context remains a separate attributed partition.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO CM and Cameroon/Cameroun territory and aliases; do not merge with a neighbouring country or import its postcode assignments.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent; retain retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check only after the pending-country sweep or a competent-authority announcement.

stages.definition: Legacy CM address metadata and synthetic planning-pack inventory.

Digest-bound UPU, MINPOSTEL and MINESUP evidence that CM currently does not require postal codes, correction of the false five-digit shipping metadata, and explicit BP, jurisdiction, rights, AGID, model and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a future current competent-authority CM postcode system and complete finite denominator of every assignment, BP distinction, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Country, region, department, arrondissement, commune, locality, address, office, BP, route, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or AGID cell and model output are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real CM API/app through normalization, loading, no-match, multiple, failure, invalid geometry, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, metadata, clear and re-search.

agid_integration.current_scope: CM no-postcode metadata, source-qualified address/place context and independent AGID spatial identity only; no CM Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignments and exact postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifacts must pass CM quality and real API/app verification.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a CM postal polygon. Independently licensed address, building or administrative context stays separate and source-qualified.
